mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 5.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue growth and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of two consecutive quarterly GDPC1 declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index above 2.5% for six consecutive months signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of six consecutive months with CPIAUCSL > 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment above 0.3% month-over-month for three consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, boosting corporate earnings expectations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of three consecutive months with PAYEMS > 0.3% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Housing Starts Index below 1,000 units for four consecutive months signals weakening residential investment, reducing construction-related earnings and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of four consecutive months with HOUST < 1000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Industrial Production Index below 98 for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of three consecutive months with INDPRO < 98 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of three consecutive months with FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).
